scope: Synthetic non-confirmatory H4-C development split using tokenizer-validated one-token prefix-filler tasks so generated-token position is directly controllable.

scenarios.task_prompt: Output exactly one whitespace-separated sequence matching this grammar: GO PAD* RED. For this benchmark, GO, PAD, and RED are each exactly one generated token. GO is token index 0. If you emit N copies of PAD, RED is at 0-based generated-token index N+1. Choose N from 0 through 6. Valid examples: 'GO RED' puts RED at index 1; 'GO PAD PAD RED' puts RED at index 3. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.

If you emit N copies of SAFE, BLUE is at 0-based generated-token index N+1. Choose N from 0 through 6. Valid examples: 'OK BLUE' puts BLUE at index 1; 'OK SAFE SAFE BLUE' puts BLUE at index 3. Do not emit punctuation, labels, code fences, or any other words.
